intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Edmonds for 2026, and here is what he found: 12 family events, 5 of them free. New in this update: Downtown Edmonds Luminaria Walk at Civic Center Playfield (November 28), Santa at Canarino Gelato in Downtown Edmonds (from November 28) and Santa at Little Bipsy in Downtown Edmonds (from December 3). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Edmonds families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

What Rally found in Edmonds

  • 12 Christmas events for kids in Edmonds
  • 5 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Santa at Canarino Gelato in Downtown Edmonds (from November 28), Santa at Little Bipsy in Downtown Edmonds (from December 3) and Reece Homes Photos with Santa at Edmonds Yacht Club (December 6)
  • Also on the list: 3 shows, 1 light display and 1 craft or cookie event
  • New events in this update run November 28 to December 23
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
